title: Take care not to harm Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultural heritage
what: Take all reasonable and practicable measures to ensure the business's activities do not harm Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander cultural heritage.

laws.title: Torres Strait Islander Cultural Heritage Act 2003 (Qld)

sources.title: Aboriginal Cultural Heritage Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person who carries out an activity must take all reasonable and practicable measures to ensure the activity does not harm Aboriginal cultural heritage (the cultural heritage duty of care )

sources.title: Torres Strait Islander Cultural Heritage Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person who carries out an activity must take all reasonable and practicable measures to ensure the activity does not harm Torres Strait Islander cultural heritage (the cultural heritage duty of care )

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Aboriginal Cultural Heritage Act 2003 (Qld)

sources.title: Aboriginal Cultural Heritage Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 46, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The chief executive may keep the register in the form or forms the chief executive considers to be the most appropriate in the circumstances for— (a) achieving the purpose of establishing the register;

reach.condition: if it carries out an activity that could harm Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander cultural heritage

confidence_note: Quoted from the register's current version, read on 18 Nov 2026. Section numbers read from the heading before each duty. The Torres Strait Islander Cultural Heritage Act 2003 sets the same duty for Torres Strait Islander cultural heritage (s 23(1)), quoted as the second source.
